subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which session and token diagnostics should user-visible context-overflow messages disclose?
rationale: The implementation can carry the data, but raw session identity and the presentation of estimated or synthetic token counts require an explicit privacy and accuracy policy.

options.title: Safe detailed diagnostics
options.body: Show provider/model, effective budget, clearly labeled token count and overage, plus a redacted channel or session display label.

options.title: Token diagnostics only
options.body: Show model and token details while omitting all session or channel identity.

options.title: Keep details internal
options.body: Keep user-facing copy generic and expose specifics only in logs and status surfaces.

recommendation.title: Safe detailed diagnostics
recommendation.body: Show provider/model, effective budget, clearly labeled token count and overage, plus a redacted channel or session display label.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cross-path overflow recovery work and prior review activity place this account closest to the product decision.
